title: Record of Deportable / Inadmissible Alien
purpose: Internal DHS record documenting information gathered about a noncitizen during an immigration encounter or investigation.
notes: Not filed by applicants. Frequently appears as evidence in removal proceedings.

title: Notice of Referral to Immigration Judge
spanishTitle: Notificación de remisión al juez de inmigración
purpose: Refers certain immigration benefit applications or proceedings to the Immigration Court for adjudication.
notes: Often encountered in asylum and other defensive proceedings.

title: Additional Charges of Inadmissibility / Deportability
spanishTitle: Cargos adicionales de inadmisibilidad o deportabilidad
purpose: Used by DHS to amend or add factual allegations or legal charges in an existing Notice to Appear.
notes: Commonly used after proceedings have already begun.

title: Notice to EOIR: Alien Address
spanishTitle: Notificación al EOIR sobre dirección del extranjero
purpose: Communicates changes or updates in address or other information between USCIS and EOIR for pending immigration court proceedings.
notes: Typically prepared by USCIS rather than the respondent.

title: Application for Advance Permission to Enter as a Nonimmigrant
spanishTitle: Solicitud de permiso anticipado para ingresar como no inmigrante
purpose: Requests discretionary permission to enter the United States temporarily despite certain grounds of inadmissibility.
notes: Commonly associated with U visa, T visa, and certain Canadian border applicants.

title: Notice of Intent to Issue a Final Administrative Removal Order
spanishTitle: Notificación de intención de emitir una orden administrativa final de expulsión
purpose: Advises a noncitizen that DHS intends to remove them through expedited administrative removal procedures.
notes: Used in administrative removal proceedings under INA § 238(b).
